class DocumentStore:
    """In-memory store of support articles keyed by id."""

    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self._docs: dict[str, str] = {}

    def add(self, doc_id: str, text: str) -> None:
        """Add or replace an article."""
        self._docs[doc_id] = text

    def search(self, query: str, limit: int = 3) -> list[str]:
        """Return up to `limit` articles containing any query term."""
        terms = query.lower().split()
        hits = [t for t in self._docs.values() if any(w in t.lower() for w in terms)]
        return hits[:limit]


def answer(store: DocumentStore, question: str) -> str:
    """Answer a question using the top matching articles as context."""
    context = "\n---\n".join(store.search(question))
    messages = [{"role": "system", "content": "Answer using only this context:\n" + context},
                {"role": "user", "content": question}]
    resp = client.chat.completions.create(model="gpt-4o-mini", messages=messages)
    return resp.choices[0].message.content

import time

import requests

TOKEN_URL = "https://auth.example.com/oauth/token"
REFRESH_MARGIN_SECONDS = 60


class TokenManager:
    def __init__(self, client_id: str, client_secret: str) -> None:
        self._client_id = client_id
        self._client_secret = client_secret
        self._token: str | None = None
        self._expires_at = 0.0

    def get_token(self) -> str:
        if self._token is None or time.time() >= self._expires_at - REFRESH_MARGIN_SECONDS:
            self._refresh()
        return self._token

    def _refresh(self) -> None:
        resp = requests.post(TOKEN_URL, data={
            "grant_type": "client_credentials",
            "client_id": self._client_id,
            "client_secret": self._client_secret,
        })
        resp.raise_for_status()
        body = resp.json()
        self._token = body["access_token"]
        self._expires_at = time.time() + body["expires_in"]

from openai import AsyncOpenAI

client = AsyncOpenAI()
AGENT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS = 120
MAX_STEPS = 8


async def _loop(messages: list, tools: list, execute) -> str | None:
    for _ in range(MAX_STEPS):
        resp = await client.chat.completions.create(model="gpt-4o", messages=messages, tools=tools)
        msg = resp.choices[0].message
        if not msg.tool_calls:
            return msg.content
        messages.append(msg)
        for call in msg.tool_calls:
            messages.append({"role": "tool", "tool_call_id": call.id, "content": await execute(call)})
    raise RuntimeError("agent exceeded max steps")


async def run_agent(messages: list, tools: list, execute) -> str | None:
    return await asyncio.wait_for(_loop(messages, tools, execute), timeout=AGENT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS)

import pandas as pd

FOUR_FIFTHS = 0.8


def impact_ratios(decisions: pd.DataFrame, category: str) -> pd.DataFrame:
    report = decisions.groupby(category)["advanced"].agg(applicants="size", selected="sum")
    report["selection_rate"] = report["selected"] / report["applicants"]
    report["impact_ratio"] = report["selection_rate"] / report["selection_rate"].max()
    report["below_four_fifths"] = report["impact_ratio"] < FOUR_FIFTHS
    return report

import pandas as pd
from fairlearn.metrics import MetricFrame, demographic_parity_ratio, selection_rate

ADVANCE_THRESHOLD = 0.7


def audit_candidate_screener(model, applicants: pd.DataFrame, features: list[str]) -> dict:
    """Selection rates and impact ratios of the candidate screener by sex and race/ethnicity."""
    advanced = (model.predict_proba(applicants[features])[:, 1] >= ADVANCE_THRESHOLD).astype(int)
    report = {}
    for category in ("sex", "race_ethnicity"):
        frame = MetricFrame(metrics=selection_rate, y_true=advanced, y_pred=advanced,
                            sensitive_features=applicants[category])
        ratio = demographic_parity_ratio(advanced, advanced, sensitive_features=applicants[category])
        report[category] = {
            "selection_rate": frame.by_group.to_dict(),
            "impact_ratio": ratio,
            "passes_four_fifths": ratio >= 0.8,
        }
    return report

from collections import defaultdict

DEFAULT_AREA_HIRE_RATE = 0.05


def postal_code_hire_rates(past_applications: list[dict]) -> dict[str, float]:
    totals: dict[str, list[int]] = defaultdict(lambda: [0, 0])
    for app in past_applications:
        t = totals[app["postal_code"]]
        t[0] += 1
        t[1] += int(app["hired"])
    return {code: hired / seen for code, (seen, hired) in totals.items()}


def candidate_features(candidate: dict, area_rates: dict[str, float]) -> list[float]:
    return [
        candidate["years_experience"],
        candidate["skills_match"],
        candidate["interview_score"],
        area_rates.get(candidate["postal_code"], DEFAULT_AREA_HIRE_RATE),
    ]


def rank_candidates(model, candidates: list[dict], past_applications: list[dict]) -> list[dict]:
    area_rates = postal_code_hire_rates(past_applications)
    scores = model.predict_proba([candidate_features(c, area_rates) for c in candidates])[:, 1]
    order = sorted(range(len(candidates)), key=lambda i: scores[i], reverse=True)
    return [candidates[i] for i in order]

import json
import sqlite3
from collections import defaultdict
from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone

db = sqlite3.connect("hiring.db")
ADS_RECORD_RETENTION = timedelta(days=4 * 365)  # keep ADS records for at least four years
IMPACT_RATIO_THRESHOLD = 0.8  # four-fifths rule

def store_screening_record(candidate_id: str, inputs: dict, score: float, advanced: bool) -> None:
    now = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
    db.execute(
        "INSERT INTO ads_records (candidate_id, inputs, score, advanced, created_at, retain_until) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)",
        (candidate_id, json.dumps(inputs), score, int(advanced), now.isoformat(), (now + ADS_RECORD_RETENTION).isoformat()),
    )
    db.commit()

def run_adverse_impact_test(outcomes: list[tuple[str, bool]]) -> dict:
    totals, selected = defaultdict(int), defaultdict(int)
    for group, advanced in outcomes:
        totals[group] += 1
        selected[group] += int(advanced)
    rates = {group: selected[group] / totals[group] for group in totals}
    best = max(rates.values()) or 1.0
    report = {group: {"selection_rate": rate, "impact_ratio": rate / best,
                      "flagged": rate / best < IMPACT_RATIO_THRESHOLD} for group, rate in rates.items()}
    db.execute("INSERT INTO bias_audits (run_at, report) VALUES (?, ?)",
               (datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(), json.dumps(report)))
    db.commit()
    return report
